source_row.rationale: Reusable, non-critical medical equipment (such as blood pressure cuffs and stethoscopes) that contacts intact skin should be cleaned/disinfected between each client use, per facility protocol, to prevent cross-contamination and transmission of pathogens between clients, since equipment can serve as a fomite for transmission if not properly cleaned.
source_row.source_detail: Shared noncritical equipment such as cuffs/stethoscopes is cleaned/disinfected before and after patient use as indicated; accessed 2026-08-14.
